title: Chapter 699 - 699 Ant; Born!

Chapter 699 - 699 Ant; Born!

Chapter 699 - 699 Ant; Born!

699 Ant; Born!

The world spun.

The next moment, Lin Fan appeared in a vast expanse of white space.

Wisps of mysterious energy revolved around him.

Lin Fan looked around curiously.

Then, he took a step forward.

Instantly, the ground beneath his feet began to move up and down violently, and a green path that was several meters wide appeared. It extended into the endless distance.

Lin Fan’s Wood Laws surged up quickly and were extremely active.

The moment Lin Fan took another step forward, the Wood Laws became even more active.

As he continued to move forward along the green path, Lin Fan had a feeling that with every step he took, his control over the Wood Laws would increase by a little.

Correspondingly, Lin Fan’s footsteps became heavier and heavier.

After walking for 100 meters, he could no longer move forward.

However, even so, Lin Fan’s Wood Laws had received a significant boost.

Helpless, Lin Fan could only take a step to the side and walk out of the green path.

Instantly, a transparent path that extended into the distance appeared before Lin Fan.

In an instant, his Water Laws began to become active.

Just like before, Lin Fan walked along the transparent path.

When he reached the point where he could no longer move forward, he changed to another path. There were the sword path, the earth path, the metal path, the spear path, the life path, the death path, the ying path, and the yang path.

When he arrived on the path of the fire element, Lin Fan did not go far.

A loud voice sounded from behind.

“You have an ant-like cultivation base, yet you still want to waste time cultivating many laws and cultivation techniques. Hmph!”

A muffled groan rang out like a thunderclap. Lin Fan could only see a man in fiery red armor flashing past from afar.

Then, Lin Fan’s entire body fell out of the river of time.

Lin Fan could not help but heave a sigh of relief.

“Who is it?”

[Zhu Yan. Cultivation: Unknown. The lord of the Fire God Palace. Because your cultivation is low but you’re cultivating many laws and cultivation techniques, he thinks you’re greedy. He has a bad impression of you. Current Hatred Points: One star.]

Seeing this…

Lin Fan was shocked at first. His cultivation level was unknown.

Obviously, this man was very powerful.

Looking at how the other party thought that he was too greedy and hated him, Lin Fan’s lips twitched.

He could cultivate as many laws and cultivation techniques as he wanted. What did it have to do with him?

Was he a police officer here?

After a while, Lin Fan finally put this matter aside.

He silently felt the vigorous power of laws in his body, as well as the surging energy. A smile that could not be hidden appeared on his face.

[Host: Lin Fan]

[Cultivation: Level-Nine Planet (6.5 billion/10 billion)

His experience points had increased by billions. The River of Time was indeed impressive!

Lin Fan slowly pushed open the door. Han Tian, Xia Xue, Xia Bing, Su Ningjing, and the others were all waiting at the door.

When they saw Lin Fan, they said happily, “Lin Fan, you’re out of seclusion?!”

Seclusion?

Lin Fan was stunned.

He seemed to have only walked a few steps in the River of Time. It did not take long, right?

How did it become seclusion?

Wait, the River of Time?

Lin Fan could not help but ask, “How long has it been?”

“It’s been half a year,” Han Tian said.

Lin Fan was shocked. As expected of something related to time. He could not feel the flow of time at all.

At this moment, Chu Yunyue walked over and said, “Lin Fan, you’re out? Hurry, Hu Tian is about to give birth!”

“Really?” Lin Fan said excitedly.

Then, his spiritual power instantly covered the entire Coiling Dragon Villa.

Soon, he saw Hu Tian lying on the bed with a big belly and her face covered in sweat.

The life force in Hu Tian’s stomach was very strong. Lin Fan could even see the baby’s small hands and calves through his mental power. The child was really about to be born!

Lin Fan did not think too much about why Hu Tian’s stomach had not changed at all in the past few years.

Now, after a few months, her belly suddenly grew so big!

His figure flashed and arrived beside Hu Tian.

Dai Weixue was shocked. “Lin Fan, why did you come in?” Get out, get out!”

Lin Fan held Hu Tian’s hand and said, “Don’t worry. I’m always here.”

After many years of cultivation, Hu Tian’s body was no longer ordinary. Giving birth was not difficult for her.

At this moment, when she saw Lin Fan’s arrival, Hu Tian’s pretty face became even more relaxed.

“Alright!” she said with a smile.

At this moment, Hu Tian’s stomach shook.

Lin Fan knew that the child was about to be born.

“I’ll wait for you outside.””

“Alright.” Hu Tian maintained her smile.

As expected, Lin Fan had only left the room for a short while when the sound of a baby crying came from inside.

“Wahhh!”

The voice was crisp and powerful.

The door opened, and Dai Weixue walked out with a baby in her arms. She said with a smile, “It’s a boy! A very beautiful boy! I’ve never seen such a beautiful boy!”

Beautiful?

That was right!

The child was beautiful!

Dai Weixue was not exaggerating.

This was because this baby was as sparkling as jade. He had big, black, and beautiful eyes, fair skin, and exquisite lips… Every part of his body seemed to have been carefully carved by the heavens.

Dai Weixue continued, “Furthermore, he started crying the moment he was born. Listen, his voice is so loud!”

“Let me carry him, Mom,” Lin Xiaoyao said excitedly.

“Why would it be you?” Dai Weixue said. “Let Lin Fan carry him first.”

As soon as she finished speaking, she slowly handed the baby in front of Lin Fan.

Lin Fan carried the baby in his arms. Looking at his delicate figure, his face was full of smiles.

‘I have a son!

‘I’ve become a father!’

It was a very strange feeling.

“Call me Daddy,” Lin Fan said.

“D-Daddy.” The baby made a very clear sound.

“Oh my god!” Dai Weixue exclaimed in surprise. ‘He actually knows how to call you ‘Daddy’! This is so amazing! He’s just born and he’s already saying ‘Daddy’!”

“Prodigy! This is definitely a child prodigy!”

“Hehehe!” The baby seemed to know that Dai Weixue was complimenting him, and his entire face broke into a smile.

Lin Xiaoyao said, “Brother, you’ve been carrying him for a while. Now it’s my turn. Come on, let me carry him.”

“Alright,” said Lin Fan.

“Be careful, don’t drop the child!” Dai Weixue said seriously.

Lin Xiaoyao was already a cultivator.

Her control of strength and reaction speed far surpassed that of ordinary people.

How could she hurt the child?

Dai Weixue’s concern made her confused.

Lin Xiaoyao looked at the adorable baby and said, “Call me ‘Aunt’. Be good and call me ‘Aunt’.

“Don’t tell me you don’t recognize me?

“Come, learn from me. Say ‘Aunt’…

“Aunt…”

However, no matter how Lin Xiaoyao taught him, the baby only looked at her with a pair of big black eyes and did not say anything.
